details: Seal is a free, open-source front-end for yt-dlp on Android. Share or paste a link from YouTube, Instagram, X, or over a thousand other sites, choose whether you want video or audio, pick the resolution and codec, and Seal downloads the file straight to your device storage — no account, no ads, no cloud in between. It embeds metadata, cover art, and subtitles into what it saves, can queue an entire playlist with a single tap, and supports aria2c as a faster parallel downloader. Power users can define custom yt-dlp command templates for full control over extraction, formats, and post-processing, and manage those templates from inside the app. The interface is pure Material You with dynamic color picked up from your wallpaper. One honest caveat: downloading is for content you have the right to save — Seal does not get around paywalls or DRM.
